legend: This is the hard version of the problem. The only difference between the two versions is the constraint on $$$|s|$$$ .

Navarro is (or was? I'm really not sure) a prominent student at the Institute of Making Ethanol, commonly known around the block as IME. He loves playing around with strings (of characters, not related to ropes) and so he also enjoys applying random algorithms to them. On one fine afternoon, he devised a simple algorithm to create a graph from a string with the following construction: two indices $$$i$$$ and $$$j$$$ are connected only if the substring $$$[i, j]$$$ is a palindrome. Seems simple right?
From the graph that's created, Navarro wants to find out the amount of connected components.
input: The input consists of a single string $$$s$$$, $$$(1 \leq |s| \leq 10^6)$$$, containing only lowercase Latin letters.
output: Output a single integer — the amount of connected components in the graph that's generated.

legend: 这就是问题的困难版本。两个版本的唯一区别在于 $$$|s|$$$ 的约束条件。
纳瓦罗是 (或者曾经是？我真的不确定) 乙醇制造研究所 (在这个街区通常被称为 IME) 的一名杰出学生。他喜欢摆弄字符串 (字符串，与绳子无关)，因此他也喜欢将随机算法应用于它们。在一个晴朗的下午，他设计了一个简单的算法，用以从一个字符串创建一个图，其结构如下：两个索引 $$$i$$$ 和 $$$j$$$ 只有在子字符串 $$$[i, j]$$$ 是回文的情况下才相连。看起来很简单，对吧？
从创建的图表中，纳瓦罗想要找出连接组件的数量。
input: 输入内容是一个仅包含小写拉丁字母的字符串 $$$s$$$、$$$(1 \leq |s| \leq 10^6)$$$。
output: 输出单个整数——生成的图中连接组件的数量。
